claims.text: VKA major bleed: rapid reversal w four-factor PCC rather than plasma,
claims.quote: For patients with VKA-associated major bleeding, we suggest rapid reversal of anticoagulation with four-factor PCC rather than with plasma

claims.text: plus vit K 5–10 mg by slow IV injection.
claims.quote: We suggest the additional use of vitamin K 5 to 10 mg administered by slow IV injection rather than reversal with coagulation factors alone
For patients taking VKAs with INRs between 4.5 and 10 and with no evidence of bleeding, we suggest against the routine use of vitamin K
For patients taking VKAs with INRs > 10.0 and with no evidence of bleeding, we suggest that oral vitamin K be administered

claims.text: FFP only if PCC unavailable; ⍉evidence it works for Xa-inhibitor bleeding.
claims.quote: It is typically used only if prothrombin complex concentrate is unavailable; there is no evidence it is effective in bleeding due to factor Xa inhibitors

claims.text: Oral Xa inhibitor bleed: if andexanet alfa unavailable, 4F-PCC may be considered;
claims.quote: If andexanet alfa is unavailable, 4-factor prothrombin complex concentrate may be considered
claims.locator: Reversal of anticoagulation: factor Xa inhibitors

claims.text: typical dose 50 U/kg IV; reserve PCC for life-threatening bleeding.
claims.quote: Typical dose is 50 units/kg IV. Because evidence of benefit is uncertain and risk of clotting is significant, prothrombin complex concentrates should be reserved for life-threatening bleeding

claims.text: Andexxa: ⍉manufactured for or sold in the US after Dec 22, 2025.
claims.quote: Andexxa will no longer be manufactured for or sold in the U.S. by AstraZeneca after December 22, 2025

claims.text: Activated charcoal if the oral Xa inhibitor was taken w.in a few hours (rivaroxaban 8 h, apixaban 6 h, edoxaban 2 h);
claims.quote: Oral activated charcoal is an option in patients who took an oral factor Xa inhibitor within a few hours of presentation (8 hours for rivaroxaban, 6 hours for apixaban, and 2 hours for edoxaban)
claims.locator: Reversal of anticoagulation: factor Xa inhibitors

claims.quote: Oral activated charcoal is an option if the last dose of dabigatran was within 2 hours

claims.text: TXA or aminocaproic acid can also be tried, but not studied for anticoagulant reversal.
claims.quote: Antifibrinolytic agents (tranexamic acid and aminocaproic acid) can also be tried; however, their use has not been studied for reversal of bleeding in patients taking anticoagulants
